screenshots.name: 01-weak-point
screenshots.caption: FIND THE WEAK POINT
screenshots.alt: A muscled demolition man punches a support column and a red brick row house collapses into dust.

screenshots.name: 02-co-op
screenshots.caption: WRECK IT WITH A FRIEND
screenshots.alt: Two demolition men smash a building from both sides while bricks and glass rain down.

screenshots.name: 03-dynamite
screenshots.caption: BRING DYNAMITE
screenshots.alt: A stick of dynamite explodes against a neon-lit building at night and the floors above start to fall.

screenshots.name: 04-tower
screenshots.caption: TOPPLE THE TOWER
screenshots.alt: A tall dockside crane tower topples onto the street.

screenshots.name: 05-wrecking-ball
screenshots.caption: SWING THE WRECKING BALL
screenshots.alt: A wrecking ball swings through the glass front of a neon arcade.

screenshots.name: 06-cities
screenshots.caption: 3 CITIES + A DAILY STREET
screenshots.alt: The level select with three cities, Town, Port and Neon, each with four streets and a daily street.

screenshots.name: 07-rainbow-stars
screenshots.caption: BEAT PAR FOR RAINBOW STARS
screenshots.alt: The results screen: three rainbow stars for a finish within par, score and cash counting up.

screenshots.name: 08-shop
screenshots.caption: UPGRADE YOUR CREW
screenshots.alt: The skill shop: upgrades for power, health, speed, dynamite and tools.
